value.title: Session status: one harness-neutral fact shape over the Plan 028 fold
value.updated: 2026-09-29 r1 dispositions: F-01 roots on StatusService::new + transcript rule; F-02 ScriptedFold sighting/msg_id + baseline test (vd-000a); F-03 status_incremental takes Option<&StatusCursor>, target-changed reset; F-04 SDK fills target, CLI always fills resolved; F-05 UNKNOWN_FACTS closed vocabulary; F-06 cp-0001 proofs; F-07 negative/missing totals are unknown, compact accumulators.

value.principles: Hexagonal, functional core / imperative shell, constructor injection, no clock or ambient lookup in core/sdk (now_ms is injected). core::status owns the SessionStatus DTOs and two ports: SessionStatusApi (explicit target -> facts) and TargetResolver (pij id / tmux pane / explicit -> target). The SDK StatusService implements SessionStatusApi over Plan 028 PrepBinding {fold, loader} + fold_source; it never calls pij, tmux or processes. Target resolution (pij list + liveness, tmux pane -> child harness process -> harness session record) is I/O in loader-query, used by the CLI path only. The CLI maps argv to queries and renders; no status semantics. crates/app is the only composition root. Status derivation is a pure function of SessionFacts + accumulated call/turn rows + now_ms.
value.composition_root: crates/app/src/main.rs dispatches `sessions status`; crates/app/src/status.rs (new) builds StatusService from the Plan 028 bindings table (crates/app/src/prep.rs) and the loader-query StatusTargetResolver. Nothing else constructs concrete loaders, folds or resolvers.
contracts: core::status (crates/core/src/status.rs), STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1. All DTOs serde (Serialize + Deserialize); timestamps are i64 epoch ms; unknown facts are None AND named in SessionStatus.unknown; a harness never reports 0 for an unrecorded fact.
Basis = native | derived | table | mtime_fallback (snake_case). Fact<T> {value: T, basis: Basis}. Table-derived values carry the table version (context.window_table = "model-windows@1").

StatusTarget {harness: String (adapter id, e.g. "claude-code"), session_id: String, transcript: Option<PathBuf>}. StatusQuery = Target(StatusTarget) | Pij(String) | Pane(String). ResolveBasis = explicit | pij_registry | native_pane. Resolved {query, target, pij_id: Option<String>, pane: Option<String>, basis, conflicts: Vec<ResolveConflict {basis, target}>}.

SessionStatus {schema_version, target, resolved: Option<Resolved>, model: ModelStatus {current: Option<Fact<String>>, current_at_ms: Option<i64>, pending_switch: Option<ModelSwitchStatus {requested: String, at_ms: Option<i64>}>, history: Vec<ModelSpan {model, first_ms, last_ms, calls}>}, context: ContextStatus {used_tokens: Option<Fact<u64>>, window_tokens: Option<Fact<u64>>, window_table: Option<String>, percent: Option<f64>, display: Option<String> ("250k of 1M (25%)")}, last_call: Option<LastCall {at_ms, input, output, cache_read, cache_write_1h, cache_write_5m (all Option<u64>), ttl_bucket: Option<Fact<String>> ("1h"|"5m"), cache_warm: Option<Fact<bool>>, stop_reason: Option<String>}>, timeline: Timeline {created_ms: Option<Fact<i64>>, last_updated_ms: Option<Fact<i64>>, idle_seconds: Option<u64>}, turns: TurnStatus {total, last_hour_total, by_origin: BTreeMap<String,u64>, last_hour_by_origin: BTreeMap<String,u64>}, compaction: CompactionStatus {counts: Option<CompactionCounts>, last: Option<CompactionSample>}, calls: CallCounts {total, sidechain}, limits_seen: Vec<LimitSeen {kind, at_ms, resets_at}>, source: SourceStatus {bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, reset: Option<String>}, unknown: Vec<String>}. CompactionCounts/CompactionSample are re-used from core::prep.

trait SessionStatusApi: Send + Sync { fn status(&self, target: &StatusTarget, now_ms: i64) -> Result<SessionStatus, StatusFailure>; } trait TargetResolver: Send + Sync { fn resolve(&self, query: &StatusQuery) -> Result<Resolved, StatusFailure>; }

StatusFailure {kind: StatusFailureKind, message} with code() and recovery() per kind: UNI-STATUS-UNSUPPORTED-HARNESS, UNI-STATUS-TRANSCRIPT-NOT-FOUND, UNI-STATUS-READ, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-UNAVAILABLE, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-UNKNOWN-SEAT, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-NO-SESSION, UNI-STATUS-DEAD-BINDING, UNI-STATUS-PANE-NOT-FOUND. Messages never carry transcript content.

SDK (crates/sdk/src/status.rs): StatusService::new(bindings: Vec<PrepBinding>, roots: Vec<PrepSourceSet>) implements SessionStatusApi, plus the embedding op `fn status_incremental(&self, target: &StatusTarget, cursor: Option<&StatusCursor>, now_ms: i64) -> Result<(SessionStatus, StatusCursor), StatusFailure>`. The caller keeps its cursor on error. StatusCursor is opaque, Clone + Send + Sync, compact (PrepResume, stat identity/anchor, target, and bounded accumulators: model spans, turn (started_ms, origin) pairs, last-call row, limit notices). Transcript rule: an explicit transcript path is read under the configured root that contains it, else under its parent directory as root; with no path, the SDK discovers under the roots for that harness and matches the file stem to session_id (Claude: <session_id>.jsonl), else TranscriptNotFound. Reads stop at the last complete record; shrink, identity change, anchor mismatch or a cursor for a different target refolds cold and sets source.reset (rotated|truncated|anchor|target-changed). incremental == cold for every field except source.

Definitions: current model = latest main-chain non-synthetic call model; pending_switch = SessionFacts.last_model_switch newer than that call; used_tokens = latest_context.total (native); window = native when recorded else model-windows@1 table else unknown; percent only when both known; ttl_bucket from last call write split (derived); cache_warm = now - last call < ttl (derived); last_updated = last_event_ms (native) else transcript mtime (mtime_fallback); Claude compaction count with zero markers = 0. ContextSample.total (i64) negative or missing maps to unknown. The SDK fills SessionStatus.target, including the transcript path read; the CLI always fills resolved (basis explicit for --session) and copies target.transcript into it. unknown uses only core::status::UNKNOWN_FACTS names (empty status lists all; the SDK removes each as filled).

value.rationale: Two behaviours run and prove independently against the frozen core::status contract and testkit fakes: the SDK StatusService (driven by testkit scripted PrepFold/PrepLoader fakes) and the CLI frontend + target resolver (driven by FakeStatusApi and injected pij/tmux/process/filesystem fakes). Composition, real-workload proof and the dependency sensor stay with the PM. Coders never import each other in the same wave.

value.responsibility: StatusService over PrepBinding + fold_source: status and status_incremental, cursor reset rules, call/turn accumulators, pure derivation of every fact per architecture definitions, model-windows@1 table, unknown list. Synthetic tests: model switch mid-session reports new model and pending switch; compaction counts and last compaction; last-hour turns by origin with injected now; TTL/warm; mtime fallback labelled; incremental == cold result; shrink/replace resets visibly; partial tail never errors. Also: update sightings of the latest call merge per field (max) so last_call reflects the final sighting; cursor for another target resets visibly.
